'''Nicholas Robert Diaz'''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nick Diaz {{!}} MMA Fighter Page |url=https://www.tapology.com/fightcenter/fighters/nick-diaz |access-date=2025-01-11 |website=Tapology |language=en}}</ref> (born August 2, 1983) is an American [[professional boxing|professional boxer]]<ref>{{cite web | url=https://boxrec.com/en/box-pro/312079 | title=BoxRec: Login }}</ref> and [[mixed martial arts|mixed martial artist]] who competed in the [[welterweight (MMA)|Welterweight]] and [[Middleweight (MMA)|Middleweight]] divisions of the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC). Diaz is a former [[List of Strikeforce champions#Welterweight Championship|Strikeforce]], [[World Extreme Cagefighting#Welterweight Championship|WEC]] and IFC [[welterweight (MMA)|Welterweight]] champion and a [[UFC Welterweight Champion|UFC title]] challenger.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Hiergesell|first=Dan|date=2021-09-24|tit
